sources.title: Online reading seminar for Zhang's bounded gaps between primes
sources.author: Terence Tao
evidence_supported: The project objective was to understand Zhang's proof and lower the bounded-gap constant.
The project began from Zhang's bound of 70,000,000.

sources.title: Bounded gaps between primes (Polymath8) - a progress report
sources.author: Terence Tao
evidence_supported: By 2013-06-30 the confirmed bound had been reduced to 12,006.
A provisional lower bound of 6,966 remained subject to checking.
The project involved multiple refinements to Zhang's argument rather than one indivisible discovery event.

sources.title: Polymath8: Writing the paper
sources.author: Terence Tao
evidence_supported: The project had provisionally reduced the bound to 4,680 by the writing phase.
The initial intensive optimization phase had stabilized by August 2013.
Distinct outputs included the main paper, admissible-tuple computation, and possible expository work.

sources.title: The bounded gaps between primes Polymath project - a retrospective
evidence_supported: The first Polymath8 phase improved Zhang's bound from 70,000,000 to 4,680.
After Maynard's breakthrough, the collaboration continued and ultimately obtained the bound 246.
The historical label Polymath8 covers more than one methodological and publication phase.

technology_dependency.rationale: Open online collaboration materially organized rapid checking, optimization, computation, and synthesis, while the underlying mathematical advances also depended on prior and parallel individual work.

aggregate_event_diagnosis.rule: Do not assign one candidate, verification, or publication date to all child phases.

remaining_questions: Preserve exact version and publication chronology for each Polymath8a and Polymath8b paper.

Separate mathematical improvements from computational admissible-tuple improvements.
Establish explicit independent verification and disciplinary acceptance evidence for each child event.
